<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Flowcatalyst\Events\Platform\Iam\User;

final readonly class UserCreatedData
{
    public function __construct(
        public array $names,
        public array $scores,
        public ?array $counts,
        public ?array $flags,
        public ?array $maybe,
    ) {}

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $data */
    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            names: $data['names'],
            scores: $data['scores'],
            counts: $data['counts'],
            flags: $data['flags'],
            maybe: $data['maybe'],
        );
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed> */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'names' => $this->names,
            'scores' => $this->scores,
            'counts' => $this->counts,
            'flags' => $this->flags,
            'maybe' => $this->maybe,
        ];
    }
}
